程序包 org.bukkit.permissions

类 PermissionAttachment

java.lang.Object
org.bukkit.permissions.PermissionAttachment
public class PermissionAttachment extends java.lang.Object
保存关于Permissible对象上权限附件的信息

原文： Holds information about a permission attachment on a Permissible object

    • getPermissions

      @NotNull public @NotNull java.util.Map<java.lang.String,java.lang.Boolean> getPermissions()
      获取此附件中包含的所有已设置权限和值的副本.

      此映射可以被修改但不会影响附件, 因为它是一个副本.

      原文： Gets a copy of all set permissions and values contained within this attachment.

      This map may be modified but will not affect the attachment, as it is a copy.

      返回:
      此附件表达的所有权限和值的副本

      原文：Copy of all permissions and values expressed by this attachment

    • unsetPermission

      public void unsetPermission(@NotNull @NotNull java.lang.String name)
      从此附件中移除指定权限.

      如果此附件中不存在该权限, 什么也不会发生.

      原文： Removes the specified permission from this attachment.

      If the permission does not exist in this attachment, nothing will happen.

      参数:
      name - 要移除的权限名称

      原文：Name of the permission to remove

    • unsetPermission

      原文： Removes the specified permission from this attachment.

      If the permission does not exist in this attachment, nothing will happen.

      参数:
      perm - 要移除的权限

      原文：Permission to remove

    • remove

      public boolean remove()
      从此附件注册的Permissible中移除此附件.

      原文： Removes this attachment from its registered Permissible

      返回:
      如果可权限对象被成功移除返回true, 如果不存在返回false

      原文：true if the permissible was removed successfully, false if it did not exist
